piece_count_integrality.explanation: Every complete cycle must use area*z/5 pieces, which must be integer
piece_count_integrality.condition: For area mod 5 = r ≠ 0, z must be divisible by 5/gcd(r,5)

gcd_explanation.4\u00d78: gcd=10: factor 5 from piece-count integrality (area=32, gcd(32,5)=1), factor 2 from SCC structure (shortest cycle=20)
gcd_explanation.5\u00d76: gcd=1: no piece-count restriction (area=30≡0 mod 5), SCC structure gives gcd=1

conclusion: The factor-5 component of the gcd is explained by piece-count integrality. The remaining factor is SCC-structure-dependent.
